periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal snout-to-ear axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with a vertical axis significantly longer than the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering towards the nasal bridge; the lowest point is notably distal from the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, extending vertically to cover roughly one-third of the visible lateral torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The inter-ear distance is approximately 1.5 to 2 times the lateral width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and rounded apex contours with no visible flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced sagittal crest present at the cranial apex, creating a distinct peaked profile.
